title: Practice exams just leveled up
body:
Your practice exams now follow the typical real-exam topic mix, and every topic has four levels: Foundation, Core, Exam-Level and Max. Do well in a topic and you move up. We added over 6,000 new questions to make it happen.

The goal: reach Max in every topic. Max questions are tougher than the real exam, so when you're there, you're ready to write.

Prefer the old style? You can switch back any time in your Profile.
